item: Row 424: the import's keyword-counter reconcile checks only the keywords the imported articles mention, and every reconcile rewrites only the counters that were wrong
summary: keyword_counter_reconcile was the largest post-swap cost after the junk scan (18.3 s of a 72 s import on lane O's bench; 30 s of lane S's 212 s restore). Two changes. (1) reconcile_keyword_counters zeroed and rewrote every keyword row per slice, one UPDATE each, although almost all were already right; it now stamps the slice with one range UPDATE and rewrites only the rows its drift scan found wrong (same end state row for row, and no reader can see a zeroed keyword); the GROUP BY and the compare now run inside the same write-gate hold as the write, so an ingest cannot commit a count between them that the write would undo (Plan's check, pinned by a test that starts a writer at that exact point, which fails with the read outside the gate). (2) New reconcile_keyword_counters_for_articles recomputes exactly the keywords the swap group's imported articles mention, with the sweep's arithmetic (all live unquarantined mentions, R101) and stamp; keywords it does not touch keep counters and stamp, so the envelope still discloses older drift. reconcile_counters_after_import (called by the import stage) uses it when the group is derived and the import is under a quarter of the corpus, then runs the budgeted insurance sweep inside what is left of the same budget unless the counters are exact AND a whole sweep landed within the freshness window: the envelope reads only keywords above 0, so a keyword stored at 0 over real mentions (pre-2026-07-29 drift) is invisible to it, and the sweep now records when its oldest slice of the last whole pass was verified (derived_meta counter_reconcile_swept_at; found by the independent read). Measured on 4 CPUs, plaintext synthetic stores (Zipf keywords, 60 per article): 3,000 articles into 300,000 with the corpus swept within the window, 13.75 s to 3.22 s; never swept, 16.32 s to 12.22 s; 122,000 into 186,000 (the sweep route), 11.46 s to 5.38 s. Pinned by a mixed golden case, 24 random corpora against the whole-corpus sweep, 6 corpora whose expected keywords come from the generator rather than the gathering query, behavioural tests of every route and of the budget handoff, a real carried import (no drift to repair, identical to the sweep) and a source pin of the stage's branches. kw engine pin kept with --same.
